title: U.S Department of the Interior Unstable Slope Management Program allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to access a…
description: The U.S Department of the Interior Unstable Slope Management Program has a vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to access an endpoint which returns a list of application users and their permissions in plaintext. This information disclosure vulnerability has a CVSS score of 5.3 (medium severity). The issue was fixed on or around October 19, 2026.
